entries.en: The analyst found aminoacetone in only one of the three samples.
entries.zh: 分析员只在三份样本中的一份里发现了氨基丙酮。

entries.meaningZh: 氨基茴香醚；氨基苯甲醚
entries.en: We had enough aminoanisole for a second run, but no clean vessels.
entries.zh: 我们有足够的氨基茴香醚再做一次实验，却没有干净的容器。

entries.en: The laboratory suspended its work with aminoazobenzene while the equipment was repaired.
entries.zh: 设备维修期间，实验室暂停了涉及氨基偶氮苯的工作。

entries.en: Her results for aminobenzaldehyde differed from those reported by the other group.
entries.zh: 她关于氨基苯甲醛的结果与另一组报告的结果不同。

entries.en: The damaged package contained aminocellulose rather than the material we had ordered.
entries.zh: 破损的包裹里装的是氨基纤维素，而不是我们订购的材料。

entries.en: The chemist isolated an aminocyclitol but had not yet established its structure.
entries.zh: 化学家分离出了一种氨基环醇，但尚未确定其结构。

entries.en: The order included aminoethanol, although the project no longer required it.
entries.zh: 订单包含氨基乙醇，尽管那个项目已经不需要它了。

entries.en: The missing shipment of aminoethylcellulose delayed the team's experiments for a week.
entries.zh: 那批氨乙基纤维素货物遗失，使团队的实验推迟了一周。

entries.en: The researchers compared aminogalactose with the related sugar used in their earlier study.
entries.zh: 研究人员把氨基半乳糖与先前研究所用的一种相关糖进行了比较。

entries.en: The first sample contained aminoglucose, whereas the control sample did not.
entries.zh: 第一份样本含有氨基葡萄糖，而对照样本没有。

entries.en: An unexpected aminoketone appeared among the products of the experiment.
entries.zh: 实验产物中出现了一种意料之外的氨基酮。

entries.en: The researchers studied three aminoketones under the same experimental conditions.
entries.zh: 研究人员在相同实验条件下研究了三种氨基酮。

entries.en: The group could detect an aminolipid but could not determine how much was present.
entries.zh: 研究组能检出一种氨基脂，却无法确定其含量。

entries.en: The second route required aminomethylation before the final purification step.
entries.zh: 第二条工艺路线需要先进行氨甲基化，再完成最后的纯化步骤。

entries.en: A mislabeled bottle of aminophenol had been delivered to the wrong laboratory.
entries.zh: 一瓶标签贴错的氨基酚被送到了错误的实验室。

entries.en: The team requested an additional sample of aminopurine to repeat the measurement.
entries.zh: 团队申请了额外一份氨基嘌呤样品，以重复测量。

entries.en: Neither technician could account for the aminopyridine missing from the inventory.
entries.zh: 两位技术员都无法解释清单中那批氨基吡啶为何不见了。

entries.en: The analysis revealed an aminosaccharide that the earlier procedure had missed.
entries.zh: 分析发现了一种先前检测程序未能检出的氨基糖。

entries.en: We repeated the test without the aminosugar to see whether the result changed.
entries.zh: 我们在不加那种氨基糖的情况下重复了试验，看看结果是否变化。

entries.en: The container of aminothiazole was intact, but its delivery papers were missing.
entries.zh: 氨基噻唑的容器完好无损，但送货文件不见了。

entries.en: The supplier withdrew the aminothiourea after discovering a discrepancy in the batch records.
entries.zh: 供应商发现批次记录有出入后，撤回了那批氨基硫脲。

entries.en: Aminta returned the borrowed suitcase with a small thank-you note inside.
entries.zh: 阿明塔归还借来的行李箱时，在里面放了一张简短的感谢便条。

entries.en: Aminu held the ladder while we fastened the banner above the door.
entries.zh: 我们在门上方固定横幅时，阿米努扶着梯子。

entries.en: Amira saved the last empty jar for the buttons she kept finding.
entries.zh: 阿米拉把最后一个空罐子留着，装那些不断被她找到的纽扣。

entries.en: Amiran noticed that the return address had been crossed out.
entries.zh: 阿米兰发现回邮地址被划掉了。

entries.en: The fictional amirate in her novel is divided by a succession dispute.
entries.zh: 她小说中那个虚构的酋长国因继承权之争而分裂。

entries.en: Amiri brought a folding stool because the hall had too few chairs.
entries.zh: 因为大厅的椅子不够，阿米里带来了一把折叠凳。

entries.en: Amit found the missing earring beneath the passenger seat.
entries.zh: 阿米特在乘客座位下面找到了那只遗失的耳环。

entries.en: Ms Amita asked us to leave the wet umbrellas outside.
entries.zh: 网田女士请我们把湿雨伞留在外面。

entries.en: Amitai carried the empty crates back to the stall before sunset.
entries.zh: 日落前，阿米塔伊把空板条箱搬回了摊位。

entries.en: Amjad offered to collect the repaired clock on his way home.
entries.zh: 阿姆贾德主动提出在回家路上去取修好的钟。

entries.meaningZh: 有源矩阵液晶显示器〔缩写〕
entries.en: The technician replaced the cracked AMLCD before returning the unit to the customer.
entries.zh: 技术员更换了破裂的有源矩阵液晶显示器后，才把设备交还顾客。

entries.en: Amli stayed behind to check that every window was closed.
entries.zh: 阿姆莱留下来检查每扇窗户是否都关好了。

entries.en: Ammann returned from the market with more bread than we needed.
entries.zh: 阿曼从市场回来，带的面包比我们需要的还多。

entries.en: Ammar put the damaged photograph between two sheets of clean paper.
entries.zh: 阿马尔把破损的照片夹在了两张干净的纸之间。

entries.en: Amme brought the wrong key but knew where the spare was kept.
entries.zh: 阿梅带错了钥匙，但知道备用钥匙放在哪里。

entries.en: Mr Ammer waited outside while the children finished their rehearsal.
entries.zh: 孩子们完成排练期间，阿默尔先生在外面等候。

entries.en: The student photographed an ammocoete through the side of the observation tank.
entries.zh: 学生隔着观察水槽的侧壁拍摄了一条幼七鳃鳗。

entries.en: An ammonifier from the soil sample was selected for further study.
entries.zh: 来自土壤样本的一种氨化细菌被选作进一步研究的对象。

entries.en: The experiment compared ammonifiers collected from two different fields.
entries.zh: 实验比较了从两块不同田地采集的氨化菌。

entries.en: The study measured ammoniogenesis without attempting to identify every contributing organism.
entries.zh: 该研究测量了生氨作用，但没有试图鉴定所有参与其中的生物。

entries.en: The ammoniometer gave inconsistent readings until the technician checked its connections.
entries.zh: 在技术员检查连接之前，氨量计的读数一直不一致。

entries.en: Ammons carried the sleeping dog away from the noisy doorway.
entries.zh: 安蒙斯把熟睡的狗从嘈杂的门口抱开了。

entries.en: The pilot study examined ammoxidation before the team designed a larger reactor.
entries.zh: 团队在设计更大的反应器之前，先通过小规模研究考察了氨氧化反应。

entries.en: Amna counted the tickets again after finding one beneath the tray.
entries.zh: 阿姆纳在托盘下面发现一张票后，又把票数了一遍。

entries.en: The lecture used a sequence of drawings to explain amniongenesis.
entries.zh: 讲座用一组连续的图画解释了羊膜形成。

entries.en: The clinic requested a replacement part for its damaged amnioscope.
entries.zh: 诊所为受损的羊膜镜申请了一个替换零件。

entries.en: Amnon checked the workshop floor for screws before moving the trolley.
entries.zh: 移动手推车前，阿姆农检查了工坊地面上有没有螺丝。

entries.en: Amodeo agreed to keep the boxes until our new flat was ready.
entries.zh: 阿莫德奥同意替我们保管箱子，直到新公寓准备就绪。

entries.en: She found an old Amoi phone among the chargers in the drawer.
entries.zh: 她在抽屉里的充电器之间发现了一部旧夏新手机。

entries.en: The gardener kept an amole beside the other plants grown for practical uses.
entries.zh: 园丁把一株皂用植物放在其他实用植物旁边。

entries.en: The botanist compared two species of Amomum before examining the dried specimens.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了豆蔻属的两个物种后，才检查干燥标本。

entries.en: The old toy pistol had an amorce still lodged inside it.
entries.zh: 那把旧玩具手枪里面还卡着一个雷管。

entries.en: The unopened parcel from Amore was waiting on her desk.
entries.zh: 爱茉莉寄来的未拆包裹正放在她的桌上。

entries.en: Amores turned back when he realised the picnic blanket was missing.
entries.zh: 阿莫雷斯发现野餐毯不见了，便折返了。

entries.en: Two carved amoretti supported the frame above the fireplace.
entries.zh: 壁炉上方，两尊雕刻的小爱神托着框架。

entries.en: An amoretto holding a wreath appeared in the corner of the painting.
entries.zh: 画的一角有一个捧着花环的小爱神形象。

entries.en: Amorim left a spare coat by the door for anyone who needed one.
entries.zh: 阿莫里姆在门边留了一件备用外套，供需要的人使用。

entries.en: We watched Amorosa after the evening's outdoor screening was cancelled.
entries.zh: 晚上的露天放映取消后，我们看了《阿莫罗萨》。

entries.en: The researchers compared the material before and after amorphization.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了材料在无定形化前后的情况。

entries.en: The material's amorphousness complicated the team's structural analysis.
entries.zh: 材料的非晶形态使团队的结构分析变得复杂。

entries.en: Amorth checked the shed before reporting that the bicycle was missing.
entries.zh: 阿莫尔特先检查了棚屋，才报告自行车不见了。

entries.meaningZh: 摊还；分期偿还〔少用拼法〕
entries.en: The accountant revised the amortisement schedule after the repayment date changed.
entries.zh: 还款日期变更后，会计修改了分期偿还计划。

entries.en: The engineer removed the worn amortisseur and compared it with the replacement.
entries.zh: 工程师拆下磨损的阻尼器，把它与替换件作了比较。

entries.en: The agreement provided for amortizement over several years rather than immediate repayment.
entries.zh: 协议规定分几年摊还，而不是立即偿还。

entries.en: Amoss brought the folding chairs back inside before the rain arrived.
entries.zh: 下雨之前，阿莫斯把折叠椅搬回了屋里。

entries.en: The old charter describes the amotion of an officer for misconduct.
entries.zh: 那份旧章程记述了因行为不当而撤换一名职员的情形。

entries.en: Amott packed the small cups separately to keep them from breaking.
entries.zh: 阿莫特把小杯子分开包装，以免打碎。

entries.meaningZh: 自尊心；虚荣心〔法语借词〕
entries.en: The public correction wounded his amour-propre more than the original mistake.
entries.zh: 与最初的错误相比，当众纠正更伤他的自尊心。

entries.en: Amoureux returned the borrowed ladder with a basket of apples.
entries.zh: 阿穆勒归还借来的梯子时，还带了一篮苹果。

entries.en: The old shipping papers record a stop at Amoy before the return voyage.
entries.zh: 旧航运文件记载，返航前曾在厦门停靠。

entries.en: The two battery packs have different amp-hr ratings but the same stated voltage.
entries.zh: 这两个电池组的安培时额定值不同，但标示电压相同。

entries.en: The engineer checked the cable's ampacity before approving the revised design.
entries.zh: 工程师在批准修改后的设计之前，核查了电缆的载流量。

entries.en: Her ampalaya was still too bitter for my taste, even after she changed the recipe.
entries.zh: 即使她改了做法，她做的苦瓜还是苦得让我吃不惯。

entries.en: Amparo left the porch light on until the last guest had departed.
entries.zh: 安帕罗让门廊灯一直亮着，直到最后一位客人离开。

entries.en: The replacement battery was rated at more ampere-hours than the original.
entries.zh: 替换电池额定的安培时数比原电池高。

entries.meaningZh: 安培时〔电量单位，合写形式〕
entries.en: The old specification gives the battery capacity as one amperehour.
entries.zh: 那份旧规格书把电池容量标为一安培时。

entries.en: The student disconnected the amperometer before rearranging the circuit.
entries.zh: 学生先断开安培计，再重新布置电路。

entries.en: The laboratory compared amperometry with the method used in its earlier study.
entries.zh: 实验室把电流测定法与先前研究所用的方法作了比较。

entries.en: The archivist kept the old Ampex beside the tapes that still needed transferring.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把那台旧安派克斯录像设备留在尚待转录的磁带旁。

entries.en: The student drew the amphiaster visible in the microscope image.
entries.zh: 学生画出了显微镜图像中可见的双星体。

entries.en: Her interest in amphibiology began with the frogs in a nearby pond.
entries.zh: 她对两栖动物学的兴趣，始于附近池塘里的青蛙。

entries.en: The geologist looked for evidence of amphibolization in the newly exposed rock.
entries.zh: 地质学家在新露出的岩石中寻找闪石化的证据。

entries.meaningZh: Amphicar 水陆两用车〔车型名〕
entries.en: The museum moved the Amphicar indoors before the exhibition opened.
entries.zh: 展览开幕前，博物馆把那辆 Amphicar 水陆两用车移进了室内。

entries.meaningZh: 地上地下结果性〔植物学〕
entries.en: The botanist investigated amphicarpy without assuming that every specimen showed it.
entries.zh: 植物学家研究了地上地下结果性，但没有预设每份标本都具有这一特征。

entries.en: The botanist magnified an amphigastrium to examine its damaged edge.
entries.zh: 植物学家放大了一片腹叶，检查其受损边缘。

entries.en: The researcher could not confirm amphigenesis from the preserved specimens alone.
entries.zh: 仅凭保存的标本，研究员还无法确认是否发生了有性生殖。

entries.en: The lecture compared amphigony with asexual reproduction in the selected organisms.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了所选生物的有性生殖与无性生殖。

entries.en: His deliberately absurd amphigouri reduced the reading group to helpless laughter.
entries.zh: 他那篇刻意写得荒诞无意义的滑稽文章，逗得读书小组笑个不停。

entries.meaningZh: 扬抑扬格；长短长格〔诗律〕
entries.en: The poet placed an amphimacer at the start of the final line.
entries.zh: 诗人在最后一行开头用了一个扬抑扬格。

entries.en: The researcher separated Amphipoda from the other small crustaceans in the sample.
entries.zh: 研究员把样本中的端足类与其他小型甲壳动物分开。

entries.meaningZh: 仅前后有柱廊的建筑〔建筑学〕
entries.en: The architect sketched an amphiprostyle with narrow steps at both ends.
entries.zh: 建筑师画了一座仅前后有柱廊的建筑，两端都有窄台阶。

entries.en: The experiment compared an ampholyte with a compound that behaved only as an acid.
entries.zh: 实验把一种两性电解质与一种只呈酸性的化合物作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 双耳细颈椭圆陶罐〔amphora 的复数〕
entries.en: The excavators found three amphorae beside the remains of a stone wall.
entries.zh: 发掘人员在石墙遗迹旁发现了三个双耳细颈椭圆陶罐。

entries.en: Ampli checked the parcel for damage before signing the delivery receipt.
entries.zh: 安普利检查包裹有无损坏后，才签收了送货单。

entries.en: The committee's proposal called for an ampliation of the museum's educational role.
entries.zh: 委员会的提案要求扩大博物馆的教育作用。

entries.en: The technician inspected the amplidyne before reconnecting the control equipment.
entries.zh: 技术员检查了电动放大机后，才重新连接控制设备。

entries.en: The ampligraph stopped recording halfway through the demonstration.
entries.zh: 演示进行到一半，摆幅记录仪停止了记录。

entries.en: The damaged amplimeter was removed from the display for repair.
entries.zh: 受损的指针式摆幅仪被从展品中撤下，送去维修。
